name: GlitchTip

evidence.errors: C02: error tracking is the first job; SDK events become grouped issues (E01)
evidence.uptime: U01, U02: HTTP and TCP checks with expected status and body match
evidence.status: C02, S01, S03: status pages group monitors, public or organization-only
evidence.logs: L02: severity, service and full-text log filters with trace links
evidence.performance: A01: transaction groups with p50 and p95 timings and span breakdowns
evidence.cron: J02: missing heartbeat marks a check down; success pings restore it

line: Open source Sentry-compatible errors, uptime and logs.
